formatting.fileFormat: Submit the manuscript as a Word document; do not submit in PDF format. Figures as separate files (1 file per figure), not in the manuscript text. Recommended individual file sizes of no more than 500 kB and not exceeding 1 MB; total for all files not exceeding 5 MB (not including video).
formatting.margins: Leave right margins unjustified (ragged); no numeric margin width is stated
formatting.pageNumbers: Start each section (title page, abstract, text, references, and as appropriate figure legends and tables) on a new page, numbered consecutively, beginning with the title page
formatting.referenceStyle: AMA Manual of Style, 11th edition. Number references in the order they appear in the text; do not alphabetize. In text, tables, and legends identify references with superscript arabic numerals. List all authors and/or editors up to 6; if more than 6, list the first 3 followed by 'et al.' Journal references include the issue number in parentheses after the volume number. AI, LLM, and chatbots must not be used to generate or format references.
formatting.coverLetter: Required: 'Include a cover letter and complete contact information for the corresponding author' and state 'whether the authors have published, posted, or submitted any related papers from the same study'.
formatting.supplement: Online-Only Supplements: 'Authors may submit supporting material to accompany their article for online-only publication when there is insufficient space to include the material in the print article.' 'The amount of online-only material should be limited and justified.' Submit as a single Word document with pages numbered consecutively; each element cited in the main text and numbered in order of citation (eTable 1, eFigure 1, eMethods). Formatting printed on the page: Arial 10-point single-spaced text; main heading 12-point bold, subheadings 10-point bold; table titles Arial 12-point bold, table footnotes 8-point; figure titles Arial 12-point bold, figure legends 8-point; photographs as .jpg or .tif at 300 dpi, 3-5 inches wide. Note: the page's visible CMS notes label the detailed formatting block for JNO/JHF, but the text is rendered on this journal's page.
formatting.titlePage: First page of the manuscript file. Include the manuscript title; the full names, highest academic degrees, and affiliations of all authors; corresponding author contact information; and the manuscript word count (not including title, abstract, acknowledgment, references, tables, and figure legends).

abstracts.other: Meta-analyses: 'Manuscripts reporting the results of meta-analyses should include an abstract of no more than 350 words' with headings Importance, Objective, Data Sources, Study Selection, Data Extraction and Synthesis, Main Outcome(s) and Measure(s), Results, Conclusions and Relevance. Original data: 'Reports of original data should include an abstract of no more than 350 words using the headings listed below'; Design, Setting, and Participants are kept as separate headings at submission; for clinical trials only, the registry name, ID, and URL go under Trial Registration. 'Abstracts are not required for Editorials, Viewpoints, and special features.' 'No information should be reported in the abstract that does not appear in the text of the manuscript.' Special Communications: the page lists them under two headings, 'Abstracts for Systematic Reviews or Special Communications' (no more than 350 words; Importance, Objective, Evidence Review, Findings, Conclusions and Relevance) and 'Abstracts for Narrative Reviews or Special Communications' (3-part, no more than 300 words; Importance, Observations, Conclusions and Relevance), so the format for a Special Communication is not pinned down by the page.

keyPoints.rules: 'In the manuscript, include a separate section called "Key Points" before the Abstract.' 'Limit this section to 75-100 words or less.' Described as 'required only for research and review manuscripts'. Question: focused question based on the study hypothesis or goal/purpose, 'Limit to 1 sentence.' Findings: results of the study/review including the design and basic numbers, significance stated without test statistics, 'Can include 1 to 2 sentences.' Meaning: key conclusion and implication based on the primary finding(s), 'Limit to 1 sentence.' Per article type: Original Investigation, Brief Report, Clinical Trial, Meta-analysis and Systematic Review require 'A list of 3 Key Points'; Narrative Review: 'No Key Points'; Research Letter: 'should not include an abstract or key points'.

The page is the shared JAMA Network instructions template rendered for this journal; visible CMS notes ('Include: ...', 'Exclude: ...', 'Comments: ...') appear beside blocks and are sometimes stale, so applicability was taken from what the page actually renders (table rows and paragraphs present), cross-checked against the three sibling pages.
No 'Editorial', 'Invited Commentary', 'Comment & Response', 'Patient Page' or 'Guide to Statistics and Methods' heading or limits appear on the page.

Use of AI, LLM, and chatbots to draft Opinion manuscripts, Letters to the Editor, and Online Comments is not permitted; any other AI use must be disclosed in the Acknowledgment section; AI must not be used to generate or format references.
All research reports need a Data Sharing Statement; research articles should follow EQUATOR reporting guidelines; a Patient Permission form is required for identifiable patients.

Reporting conventions: P values as 'P<.001' below .001 and 'P>.99' above .99; frequency data as 'No. (%)'; conventional units with SI conversions in parentheses at first mention; no abbreviations in the title or abstract.

Tables: titles preferably no longer than 10 to 15 words, single-spaced 10- or 12-point font, placed at the end of the manuscript file, not embedded as images. Figures: titles preferably 10 to 15 words, no more than 4 panels unless justified, each figure no larger than 1 MB, minimum resolution ≥350 ppi (photographs/illustrations) or ≥600 ppi (line drawings), no pie charts or 3-D graphs.
Multimedia: video ≤25 MB at submission, preferably ≤5 minutes, title ≤100 characters with spaces; audio ≤25 MB, ≤5 minutes.

Up to 2 co-corresponding authors on a limited basis; all authors must meet the four ICMJE criteria and complete the Authorship Form; conflict-of-interest disclosures cover the 3 years before submission.
unread: All three 100,000-character chunks of the page were fetched (offsets 0, 100000, 200000) and the page ends inside the third chunk. The fetch tool summarizes each chunk with a reader model that reported '[Content truncated due to length...]' markers inside some chunks (the reader may not have examined every middle passage), so the article-type table, every article-type paragraph, Key Points, Abstracts, References, Tables, Figures, Supplements, and Cover Letter sections were re-queried with targeted verbatim-quote requests; values here come from those quotes. Not independently seen: the raw HTML (Cloudflare blocks direct download).
